subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw add a true soft-steer lifecycle beyond boundary steering, and if so what abort/resume and transcript semantics should it guarantee?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally protect model/tool-boundary steering and tool-result pairing, so true pause-or-abort injection is a core runtime product decision rather than a local repair.

options.title: Keep #10960 as lifecycle design tracker
options.body: Continue landing narrow active-run admission fixes under #48003 while using this issue for the broader product/runtime semantics.

options.title: Scope OpenClaw to boundary steering only
options.body: Document that steer means model-boundary input only and close or re-scope true mid-generation pause/resume requests.

options.title: Implement full soft-steer now
options.body: Approve a cross-runtime design that interrupts active work, preserves transcript/tool-pairing invariants, injects user input, and resumes safely.

recommendation.title: Keep #10960 as lifecycle design tracker
recommendation.body: Continue landing narrow active-run admission fixes under #48003 while using this issue for the broader product/runtime semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active maintainer-labeled adjacent PR and are best positioned to decide whether the narrow admission path should remain separate from this broader lifecycle design.
